baseline_identifiability.reason: Cost denominator is fixed in advance to B-COLD (cold re-derivation of the SAME carrier), never B-NO-REPAIR or fetch ratio alone. B-COLD is strong: success 1.0 (V5 >= 0.90), prior audited product counters 18 (L=2), 19 (L=3), 20 (L=4). Treatment (T-REPAIR-REUSE) shares carrier, substrate, seeds, perturbations and differs only in physical resolve/fetch/verify count for first task id (reuse 17 vs cold 18/19). Identity directly evidenced by emitted per-operation logs (A6 fix). T-REPAIR-CONSERVATIVE and T-REPAIR-LEGACY are explicitly excluded from classifier (controls/sensitivities only); conservative L=3 ratio used only as pre-declared bound in ROBUST tier. Registered equal-weight counter is NOT re-tuned; weight grid only reports sign changes on predeclared monotone reweightings.

control_sensitivity.reason: Distinct, non-tautological controls cover each failure mode; the previously degenerate control is now verified sensitive. Positive control: PC-BASE-LIVENESS scored inside every trial, base_liveness=true observed in DESIGN canary. Perturbation-bites: B-LITERAL-REPLAY must fail (observed 0.0 in DESIGN canary). Abstention: B-NO-REPAIR must fail (observed 0.0 with guard fired). Guard specificity: NC-NO-PERTURBATION and NC-NOISE must NOT fire (observed stale=false in DESIGN). Over-broad: NC-OVERBROAD-REPAIR must detect breakage; corrected instrument measures 4/4 unaffected breakage (rate 1.0 > 0.10) for all three classes, versus parent's structurally impossible 0.0 (audit F1/A1). Replication: T-REPAIR-LEGACY must reproduce prior >1.00 at L=2 (V13). No control is supplied the answer given to treatment (over-broad rewrite applied blindly from repaired target mechanism, not answer key).

treatment_liveness.reason: Treatment arm structurally capable of execution. Uses same shipped carrier that DESIGN probes executed end-to-end (distill -> resolve EXECUTABLE -> fetch 200 -> verify True). Repair-signal probe shows local_repair produces patched mechanism with probe body for all three classes. Corrected contamination probe uses in-support id (14) and returns verified live baseline on every resource. Prior audited packet showed this carrier's repair succeeds 12/12 on perturbed resources (contamination half invalidated only by helper, now fixed). Self-attacks recorded: (i) repair routine mis-parses live signal -> FUNCTIONAL-FAIL (reportable outcome, not design break); (ii) carrier support rejected task ids -> resolve EXPLORE (probes explicitly verify in-support resolution); (iii) advantage depends on repair not forced to re-resolve -> bounded by T-REPAIR-CONSERVATIVE surface AND directly tested by weight grid; (iv) success rates at 1.0 ceiling but outcome is cost ratio with live cost range (reuse 17 vs cold 18/19/20), certified in measurement_validity.
